name: grid

header_row.note: Item Switch: the frequency choice row; Stage Switch: a page/count row ('24 of 80 on')

rules: Cells run left to right, top to bottom: col = i % 6, row = i // 6; cell top-left = (104 + col * 76, 122 + (row - first_row) * 68).
4 rows show at a time (24 cells). More rows scroll by one row (kit scroll event, pitch 68), keeping the cursor one row from either edge; the kit scroll track sits at x 572.
Any count fits: vanilla Item Switch is 31 cells (6 rows), m-ex Random Stage Switch up to 80+ (14 rows). The disc art is the cell's 64x56 slot.
Footer: A toggle, X all on, Y all off, B back. The header row is a normal list row (its widget: choice for frequency).
